## 1. MARKET CONTEXT

**LLY:** Strikes too wide ($5-10 increments), difficult to dial in precise delta; better opportunities elsewhere.

**OKLO:** High-risk ticker (99% IV) with poor liquidity (OI <500), unacceptable risk/reward despite elevated premium.

**TEM:** High-risk ticker (109% IV) with erratic pricing, zero volume across all strikes signals unreliable fills.

**SHOP:** HV rank 91 attractive but liquidity concerns (zero volume all strikes, OI <200 for target deltas).

**HOOD:** Decent setup but lower priority vs AMZN/MSFT with similar delta profiles and better risk/reward.

**PLTR:** High-risk ticker (117% IV) with extreme volatility (range $106-$207), premium not worth the whipsaw risk.

**GILD:** Inconsistent IV across strikes (28%-48% range) suggests unreliable pricing, skip for cleaner setups.
